pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft emotional piano intro, quiet night atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
You said you were tired of love
but I kept the words inside
afraid the truth might break you

So many things I swallowed
like letters never sent
they stayed between my breaths

Once I wanted every hour
to stay close to you
now your name feels distant
even when I say it softly

[Chorus]
I want to leave
but my feet stay still
something quiet keeps holding me

It isn't love
not the way it was
it's the weight of sorry

I just want to breathe again
so tonight I'll loosen your hand
love was once so large
that all I can say now is

I'm sorry I loved you

[Verse 2]
You probably never knew
how long I was hurting
behind the easy smile

When I said I'm okay
it wasn't a lie
I was only trying to keep us warm

I told myself many nights
maybe twenty-four times or more
leaving first might be

the only kindness
I still have to give

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and fragile)

[Bridge]
Like a letter written
with quiet tears
I fold the ending slowly

I'm sorry
but I want to live too
so tonight I open the door

[Chorus]
I'll let go of your hand
and the silence between us
will finally breathe

Love hurts
because it once stayed
so gently inside us

Thank you
and I'm sorry
for choosing myself this time

[Outro]
(soft fading piano outro)

I close the door quietly

I loved you

I'm sorry

now I go
